help.title: Rules
help.p1: Veritas lists binary event contracts. Each contract is Yes or No on a Pyth feed versus a threshold at expiry.
help.p2: Create requires a seed greater than 1 USDT. The seed sets initial liquidity. The creator is not blocked from trading.
help.p3: Buy Yes or Buy No spends collateral for inventory of that side. Switch swaps one side for the other. Merge burns equal Yes and No for collateral before settlement.
help.p4: Liquidity providers deposit collateral and receive LP shares. Accrued Yes/No inventory is pending until withdrawal. There is no separate claim instruction; pending is paid on Remove liquidity.
help.p5: Settlement posts a Pyth PriceUpdateV2. The print must be the first update after expiry: publish_time ≥ end_ts and prev_publish_time < end_ts. The print exponent must match the market. A first print later than 10 seconds after expiry voids the market (Burn).
help.p6: Anyone may submit settlement during the 48-hour window. After the window, anyone may void an unresolved market. Resolved winning inventory redeems 1:1. Voided inventory redeems 2:1.
help.p7: Service fee is 30 bps on trades, credited to LPs. Quotes in the UI are conservative estimates, not a full pm-AMM port. Slippage protection is applied on send.
help.p8: Prices on the tape come from on-chain Pyth push-oracle accounts (shard 0). Settlement prints are posted from Hermes through the Pyth receiver. There is no app backend.

errors.notOpen: Market is not open. Wait until it is live, or void it after the window.
errors.cannotRedeem: Market is not resolved or voided. Submit settlement or wait.
errors.cannotMerge: Market is not in a state that allows merge or LP withdrawal. Use a live, resolved, or voided market.
errors.expired: Market has expired. Trading is closed; submit settlement if the window is open.
errors.outsideWindow: Outside the 48-hour settlement window. Void the market instead.
errors.invalidAmount: Amount or expiry is invalid. Seed must be > 1 USDT and expiry in the future.
errors.notEnoughTokens: Insufficient token balance. Reduce size or fund the account.
errors.emptyPool: Pool reserves are empty. This market cannot trade.
errors.slippage: Output is below slippage protection. Increase slippage or reduce size.
errors.lpZero: LP amount must be greater than zero.
errors.wrongMint: Mint does not belong to this market. Use the market Yes/No mint.
errors.onlyWinner: Only the winning token can be redeemed. Switch to the winner or wait for void rules.
errors.invalidPrice: On-chain price is out of range. Retry; if it persists the pool is too skewed.
errors.invalidLiquidity: Liquidity math rejected the size. Reduce the LP amount.
errors.invalidBudget: Seed budget is invalid. Increase the seed above 1 USDT.
errors.notFirstPrint: This Pyth print is not the first after expiry. Fetch a later print and retry.
errors.exponentMismatch: Pyth exponent does not match this market. Use the feed preset recorded on the market.
errors.accountMissing: Account not found. Confirm the address and cluster.
errors.badAddress: Program ID or mint is not a valid public key. Reset Settings.
errors.noSol: Not enough SOL for fees. Airdrop or transfer SOL.
errors.rpcAuth: RPC rejected the request. Check the API key.
errors.txFailed: Transaction failed. Retry, or inspect logs on the explorer.
errors.mintNotFound: Collateral mint not found. Check Settings.
errors.decode: On-chain account could not be decoded. The cluster may still be on the previous layout.
errors.pythFetch: Pyth Hermes did not return a print. Check the network and retry.
errors.pythNoPrint: No first Pyth print after expiry is available yet. Wait for the next publish, then retry.
errors.pythSdk: Pyth receiver SDK failed to load. Settlement posting cannot run in this build.
